texts.error.bios_not_read: The boot ROM '%1' is missing or could not be read.
texts.error.link_refused: '%1' cannot use the link cable of this machine.
texts.error.no_file: No cartridge file is in the project.
texts.error.rejected: Gearsystem could not load '%1' as a cartridge.
texts.error.save_refused: The save '%1' does not fit this cartridge's battery RAM.
texts.firmware.ggbios.about: The Game Gear's own boot ROM (1 KiB), a dump of your console's. It runs when 'Run the boot ROM' is on.
texts.firmware.smsbios.about: The Master System's own boot ROM, a dump of your console's. It runs when 'Run the boot ROM' is on. Any version works; the one you use is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same file.
texts.setting.allowupdown.about: Let Up and Down, or Left and Right, be held at the same time, which no real pad can do. When this is off, the direction pressed first wins. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.bios.about: Start the console with its own boot ROM, as the real one does. The boot ROM is a file you bring. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.fmvolume.about: How loud the FM sound chip is, in percent. It changes the sound only.
texts.setting.ggmodel.about: Automatic runs a Game Gear cartridge as Gearsystem finds it, and any other cartridge in the Game Gear's Master System mode. The early and late models differ in small details. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.glasses.about: For a game made for the 3D glasses: show the pictures of both eyes, or only those of the left or the right eye. It changes the picture only.
texts.setting.hideleftbar.about: Some Master System games leave a column of garbage at the left edge. Automatic hides it when the game blanks it itself. It changes the picture only.
texts.setting.mapper.about: The cartridge's memory hardware. Automatic follows Gearsystem's list of games; change it only for a cartridge that does not work. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.nospritelimit.about: Draw every sprite on a line, not only the first eight. There is less flicker, but some games then look wrong. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.overscan.about: Show the border around the picture: above and below, or on all sides at one of two widths. It changes the picture only.
texts.setting.port1.about: What is plugged into the first controller port: a pad, nothing, the Light Phaser gun, the Paddle Control or the Sports Pad. They move with their axes in the controller settings. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.port2.about: What is plugged into the second controller port. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.psgvolume.about: How loud the console's own sound chip is, in percent. It changes the sound only.
texts.setting.region.about: A Japanese console or one sold elsewhere (export); games can tell them apart. International is a Game Gear sold everywhere. Automatic follows the cartridge. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.sgmodel.about: The SG-1000 II has slightly different colours. The Othello Multivision is an SG-1000. Automatic follows Gearsystem's list of games. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.system.about: Which console runs the cartridge. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.timing.about: NTSC runs at 60 frames a second, PAL at 50. Automatic follows Gearsystem's list of games. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.ym2413.about: The YM2413 FM sound unit, which some Master System games use for their music. Off takes it out of the machine. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.cart_gg.help: The Game Gear cartridge ROM. A Master System cartridge here runs in the Game Gear's Master System mode.
texts.slot.cart_gg2.help: P2's Game Gear cartridge ROM, for the console on the right. Leave it empty and that console runs its own copy of P1's cartridge.
texts.slot.cart_sg.help: The SG-1000, SG-1000 II or Othello Multivision cartridge ROM.
texts.slot.cart_sms.help: The Master System or Mark III cartridge ROM.
texts.slot.cart_sms2.help: P2's Mark III cartridge ROM, for the console on the right. Leave it empty and that console runs its own copy of P1's cartridge.
texts.slot.savedata.help: The cartridge's battery RAM as Export Save Data wrote it (battery.sav), to start the game from. Leave it empty to start with no save.
texts.slot.savedata2.help: P2's cartridge's battery RAM as Export Save Data wrote it (battery2.sav), to start from. Leave it empty to start with no save.
